title: run -- the run manifest (run.yaml v5), with the certificate as a $def
$comment: Generated mirror of contracts/run.md v5.1.0 (P3 resolution) -- the .md is the source of truth; regenerate on any bump (CONTRACT-HDR-1).
description: Root = run.yaml v5 (run.md R1), the declarative unit of swarm work; canonicalized (RFC-8785 over the YAML-parsed object), frozen at run_open, refuse-on-mutation (R1.2). Operator-boundary STRICT (template R5) for the 5.1.0 emit shape -- additionalProperties false; the Conductor REFUSES unknown MAJOR and warns+ignores unknown MINOR fields at read (R1 schema line, R12). Absent-field defaults are R1's, never reader-invented. $defs carry the R8.1 certificate (the output type of the named fold).

schema.$comment: e.g. hypercell.run/5.0 -- Conductor REFUSES unknown MAJOR, warns+ignores unknown MINOR fields

goal.$comment: operator's wording VERBATIM (F1: wording is a diversity axis; the null arm receives THIS wording -- R7)

class_hints.$comment: optional operator hint to the intake classifier (R6)

topology.$comment: a policy row over ONE driver, never a loop (R3); SIX values -- the R3 table prints seven rows because tournament x ucb is a dispatch PRESET, never a seventh topology (s2-23); convergent rows REQUIRE oracle + realized weights_family count >= 2 + injected arm-zero (R1.1 rule 1)

slot.$comment: slot names unique; claim-id = run/slot/index (R1.1 rule 5); defaults to the role stem (R12)

diversity.$comment: PER-SLOT diversity vector (A6): declared here, MEASURED at round 1 (divergence floor D3)

wording_variant.$comment: ids into the role's variant table

seed.$comment: auto -> distinct per cell; or an explicit list (reproducibility)

on_missing.$comment: missing family key at open; weights are NEVER silently substituted

refiner_mode.$comment: round-structured topologies only (R5.3): fresh = new cells each round reading the frontier (no self-anchoring); persistent = nuclei carried (stateful tasks). Fold-visible, certificate-recorded

lane_prefs.$comment: hints; econ floats host/effort/cache/batch, MUST NOT float weights (the diversity axis)

roster.$comment: arm-zero MAY be declared; if omitted the Conductor INJECTS it for every convergent topology (R7)

oracle.$comment: R18: the oracle STACK artifact (contracts/oracle.md sec 3) is THE single home of every trust-side predicate knob -- exactly five in convergence: {target, tolerance, divergence_eps, contested_blocks_champion, contested_cap}, plus growth{} and the probe pin -- frozen at run open; the manifest MUST NOT restate them (two homes is the F14 drift class). EXCEPTION [R25]: null_arm is a NULL POLICY, not a trust predicate -- it lives in this manifest's null: block, never in the stack; stable_k is a MANIFEST knob (termination{})

gen.$comment: generation PIN; scores compare only within a generation (A12)

invalid_rate_halt.$comment: RESTORED v2 sec 5 R%: INVALID rate > R% => HALT oracle-sick (never converge on the minority that graded); R1.1 rule 6

grounding.$comment: A11. Floor keyed to oracle kind: judged => required is the legal minimum; tighten only (R1.1 rule 3)

sample_rate.$comment: RESTORED v2 sec 5 k%: blind second adjudication of operator-adjudicated cases (mechanics: oracle.md sec 13.1); manifest-declared so the certificate can echo it

purposes.$comment: v2 sec 7 split, ENFORCED as escrow scopes (pricebook.md sec 4.6): sum <= usd_cap; oracle_growth <= 0.2 x usd_cap (R1.1 rule 2); verification is a RESERVE production cannot eat (BUDGET-RAZOR)

pricebook.$comment: PIN pricebook.yaml@sha256:...; the certificate cites it

termination.$comment: EVENT-TIME, never wallclock (parking cannot corrupt convergence). KNOB HOME (R18): the MANIFEST owns the termination{} knobs (incl. stable_k), invalid_rate_halt, null:, and operator_audit{}; the oracle stack's convergence: block owns {target, tolerance, divergence_eps, contested_cap, contested_blocks_champion} -- ONE home each (oracle.md sec 3; F14's fix)

max_rounds.$comment: unit per topology row (R3); positive integer (R1.1 rule 6)

stable_k.$comment: consecutive VALID scoring events with no champion improvement under one gen (F14's one-definition fix); gen bump resets; counted by the run engine; positive integer (R1.1 rule 6)

self_clock_min_events.$comment: R14 guard (s6-15): a SELF-CLOCKED round_open is legal only after >= this many new VALID scoring events since the previous round_open; under-frequency rows are VOID-AT-FOLD (round-churn cannot burn max_rounds toward a premature exhausted verdict); default 1

wallclock_alarm_s.$comment: an ALARM: fires PARK + operator notice, never a verdict

null.$comment: R17: this block is oracle.md sec 12.1's NullPolicy block VERBATIM (the ONE grammar home; regenerated by COPY, s2-21); the earlier null_policy:{mode, family, floor, audit_rate} spelling is REPEALED -- one grammar, no translator. [R25] the null policy -- including whether an arm is REQUIRED -- lives HERE, never in the oracle stack's convergence block. The two-mode class lifecycle: UNSETTLED => matched (protected arm outside UCB, matched-dollar reservation at run_open); CALIBRATED => floor (inline arm at floor_frac + audit_rate matched replays). Reservation durability (s6-06): the protected reservation is res:durable-class -- survives park/crash, folds STILL-HELD on resume, or resume re-takes it FIRST; exhaustion with the required null unrun => verdict{exhausted: null-starved}, never a champion

null_arm.$comment: [R25] KNOB HOME (manifest side, never the oracle stack's convergence block). required => the Conductor injects arm-zero when the roster omits it, and BUDGET-RAZOR refuses a champion whose null never ran (verdict{exhausted:null-starved}, sec R7.1).

mode.$comment: auto = derived from the null ledger at the deepest task-class level (the default and the law); explicit pins are receipted; floor refused for unsettled classes

pin.$comment: PRE-REGISTERED strongest-single-family -- NEVER chosen by the machinery under audit (v2 sec 5)

provenance.$comment: the CLOSED canonical pair (oracle.md 12.1, R17; the old 'rank' spelling is gone)

ref.$comment: grammar: artifact://rankings/...#sha256=... (dated external ranking, facts-with-dates); operator-pin: null

as_of.$comment: the date the pin/ranking was taken (facts-with-dates)

m.$comment: settledness + flip-evidence threshold the flip predicate P(C) reads (R7.3 / oracle.md 12.4); default 5

floor_frac.$comment: floor mode: protected reservation fraction of the production cap, RESERVED at run open; default 0.10

audit_rate.$comment: floor mode: fraction of runs followed by a matched-dollar replay (default 0.25 so the trailing k=20 window holds >= m=5 audited rows by construction)

anyOf.$comment: an explicit {l0,l1,l2} object overrides WITH a receipt

priority.$comment: multi-run fleet scheduling (R10); default class by surface: hc talk -> interactive, hc apply/run -> standard, routines -> maintenance

partial_view.$comment: round-structured convergent topologies: MUST default true (R5.2 -- the all-same-diet round is unconstructable)

resume_from.$comment: import artifacts+history from a prior run_id (new run, new id; R1.2)

certificate.$comment: run.md R8.1 -- the output type of the named fold (else it is a press release); every field recomputable by hc verify: fold the span, recompute, diff MUST be empty (CERT-1). Fanout runs emit a synthesis report, never a certificate (L-HONEST-VERDICT)

null_usd.$comment: ONE member (R15/canon #6): a production/invoice usd split is render-side (the R7.2 null ledger keeps the pair locally), never the wire join key

margin_invoice.$comment: the operator's unit; the flip predicate keys here

vs_null.$comment: R15 canonical members {null_score, null_usd, margin_production, margin_invoice} -- margin_*, never lift_*; dual-unit accounting at matched-production AND matched-invoice

unscored.$comment: BUDGET-RAZOR: unscored submissions excluded from champion selection, LISTED here

apparatus_usd.$comment: apparatus-INVALID spend folds run-level, never to arm.usd_spent (R2.5)

defect.$comment: true under an operator diversity waiver (R1.1 rule 1)

views_law.$comment: partial-view law held every round (RE-10 recompute)

spend.$comment: certificate spend recompute is a TWO-LOG consistency check: Medium cost{} groups vs conductor-ledger escrow folds MUST agree (R11)

signature.$comment: [SECURITY-SEAM: cert-signing] -- seat 10: Stage-1b conductor key over the canonicalized cert body; verify procedure and key custody in identity-firewall.md (prose-deferred)
